cases.data: Route: /admin/[chapterId]/events. Bind placeholders only to known synthetic ph/hk fixtures. Desktop 1365×900; phone 390×844.

cases.blocker: Browser zoom/keyboard plus representative phone/tablet or equivalent lab setup.
